title: Container Bookings: Request Size, Timing and Channel Limits by Tier
content:
This card sets out, for every Container Bookings product of Aurelia Hanse Line, the size, timing and channel limits that shape a booking request, together with the time the line allows itself to answer one.

## What each column means

- **Container ceiling**: the largest number of containers that one booking may carry.
- **Booking horizon**: the greatest number of calendar days by which the requested departure may fall after the day the request is made.
- **Lead time to cargo cut-off**: the fewest hours that must separate the request from the cargo cut-off of the vessel asked for.
- **Channels**: the routes through which the tier may be booked (online portal, EDI, customer service desk).
- **Cargo categories**: the handling categories the tier takes (general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge).
- **Answer time**: the longest the line may take, counted in hours from receipt of a request, to confirm or decline it.

## Tier table

| Booking product | Container ceiling | Booking horizon (calendar days) | Lead time to cargo cut-off (hours) | Channels | Cargo categories | Answer time (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 10 | 42 | 72 | online portal | general | 24 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 20 | 42 | 48 | online portal, EDI | general, reefer | 24 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 50 | 56 | 24 | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 12 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 50 | 56 | 24 | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods, out of gauge | 8 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 30 | 42 | 48 | online portal, customer service desk | general, reefer, dangerous goods | 4 |
| AHL Premium Express | 20 | 28 | 24 | online portal, EDI, customer service desk | general, reefer | 2 |

## Reading the card

**Which products take dangerous goods at all?** Only AHL Contract Booking, AHL Contract Priority and AHL Guaranteed Loading list that category; out-of-gauge cargo is open solely to the two contract-rated products.

**Which products can be placed through the customer service desk?** Every product except the two spot products, which are closed to that channel; EDI, for its part, is not open to AHL Spot Saver or AHL Guaranteed Loading.

**Hypothetical sizing check.** Suppose a shipper wishes to place 25 containers of general cargo on one booking through the online portal. The container ceiling alone rules out AHL Spot Saver (10), AHL Spot Flex (20) and AHL Premium Express (20), while AHL Contract Booking, AHL Contract Priority (50 each) and AHL Guaranteed Loading (30) have room for it. The figures in this example are illustrative inputs only; whether such a request is admitted also depends on the remaining admission rules of the product.
